yourNature_desc: You are the plant that looks delicate on an old wall and has quietly moved the stones by year's end. You run short of Wood, and you ration what you have against the day it is gone. Since you need to know you will never run dry, you wait for an opening ahead of making one yourself. You pay for that caution with every chance you never feel ready to take.

self_card.face: Green held close to the stone
self_card.presence: You save your strength for the moment it counts and get by on less than you need. You stay upright on that thrift longer than you ever let yourself admit.

_trace.yourNature_desc: Wood in short supply makes the reader ration it out of a need never to run dry, and the cost is every chance never taken
_trace.presence: the held-back supply as thrift, its cost the strain never admitted
